source.work: pstack principles (boundary, domain, reader load, idempotency, legacy deletion, proof)
source.paraphrase: A command that can run twice because of a crash or a retry must converge to the same end state. A payment create without a stable key does not.

invariants.why: Those calls move money. Without a key, a timeout and a retry post the operation twice.
invariants.fixHint: Pass an idempotency key that is stable for the business operation, not a fresh random value per attempt.
invariants.avoid: The word only has to appear in the call's text, so a comment above the call does not count and a decoy field name that contains idempotency does. Calls that are not on this object list are out of scope. Designing the key so a retry converges is still judgment.
